subject: Trade Brigade Newsletter Scans 💰 02/03/25

self_score.opener:
Tariff this... tariff that...

I'll tell you one thing I am not: a tariff expert.

I don't know if these last a week, a month, a year.
I don't know how the supply chain will be impacted.
I don't know how the trade balance will resolve.

However as traders, we don't need to be experts.

I do know vol

swing_ideas.text: Possible inverted head and shoulders in the making. Keep in mind that it will have to break the neckline at 450 for the trigger to be valid, so lets not jump the gun. Thin structure retracement would be the target at 487.

Great looking bull flag over the prior pivot high. So long as price can stay over 466, looking for a bull flag to develop into blue sky territory. Deeper pullbacks than that would need to support over the daily 50 SMA (blue) to remain interesting.

Daily balance range with a pinch between the 50(blue) and 200(green) daily SMA. If price can break into the overhead range over 32.4 looking for a move into the 34.3 top of the prior balance. Not interested if it never breaks the key level.

Day one of the breakout on Friday. Looking to see if price can maintain a higher low over the breakout level at the 173.75 level for continuation over time. Next overhead target is around 188.75. Daily closes back below the 173.75 level invalidate the breakout.

Similar to DE at a cheaper price point. Looking for a move to hold over the 13.70 level to continue the bull flag consolidation. Great first step with the hammer on Friday. If price closes below the 13.7, looking for a deeper pullback to 12 for re-evaluation.

Possible bull flag over the prior resistance shelf at 86.5. Looking for a move to get back into the gap overhead if the buyers can keep higher lows over the level. Not interested if we start seeing daily bars close below the 86.5.
